body_markdown:
Nortech Systems is proud to unveil its refreshed brand identity, reflecting our commitment to innovation, quality, and strategic partnerships. Designed with our customers in mind, this reimagined brand embodies a modern and forward-thinking approach to contract manufacturing. From integrated fiber optic and printed circuit board (PCB) solutions to electromechanical systems, our goal remains clear—to deliver excellence in critical applications across medical (imaging and devices), aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors.


**Why the Change?**


The business landscape continues to evolve, and organizations must adapt to new challenges and opportunities. Nortech’s rebranding is not just the look and feel of our new logo; it is a signal of our modernized approach to **contract manufacturing** , designed to address the increasingly demanding requirements of our global partners. By blending **advanced engineering, design, and manufacturing expertise** with innovative integrated **fiber optic & PCB solutions** and unparalleled data management capabilities, Nortech ensures we deliver high quality results on time and complete.


Our refreshed identity also embodies our mission to **solve complex challenges** while enabling our customers to grow and thrive, through both strategic insights and flawless execution.


The new Nortech brand launched at MD&M Minneapolis in October at the Minneapolis Convention Center


Nortech team members Dave Schoenbauer and Corey Hancock meet with customers at 2024 MD&M Minneapolis


The decision to revitalize Nortech’s brand goes beyond aesthetics. It’s about transforming how we connect with our customers, employees, and communities. Nortech has always been a trusted partner in the industries we serve, but today’s fast-changing markets demand more proactive, collaborative partnerships. Our new brand reflects this shift, aligning with a world that prioritizes precision, digital integration, and sustainable growth.


“Our new identity is about more than just design. It’s about reinforcing our long-standing dedication to building closer connections with our customers, employees, and the communities where we do business,” said **Jay D. Miller, CEO of Nortech Systems.** “At Nortech, our customer-centric approach has always been at the core of our business. Our rebrand highlights our position as a forward-thinking partner, reaffirming our unwavering commitment to excellence in every solution we provide.”


In addition to the new tagline “Connections Reimagined” the new brand features an updated logo with a new font, color palette and brand icon which signifies connections and moving forward. The new brand identity, combined with a refreshed Mission and Vision, was developed as a result of in-depth research with customers, employees, leaders and other stakeholders. Minneapolis agency[Russell-Herder](https://russellherder.com/) partnered with Nortech to develop the new brand.


Nortech highlighted the new brand as a sponsor of the 2024 American Cancer Society Gala in November


## Nortech Mission and Vision


**The Company’s new Mission Statement** is: To deliver exceptional value by solving complex challenges with innovative, customized engineering, design, manufacturing, and data management for the critical markets we serve.


**The New Vision Statement** is: To transform connections with the world’s leading companies and the vital data needed to solve complex challenges.


## What Sets the New Nortech Apart?


At Nortech, we’ve built our reputation on delivering solutions where failure is not an option. Whether it’s a crucial medical imaging device, cutting-edge aerospace technology, or robust industrial systems, industry leaders turn to us for reliability and flawless performance.


For our customers, this rebranding strengthens our role not just as a supplier but as a strategic advisor. We don’t just deliver components; we provide value by identifying problems, sharing insights, and helping you explore alternatives. Our experience across market segments enables us to guide you through potential risks and emerging opportunities. Together, we’ll shape strategic solutions that drive your success.


Here are just some of the benefits you’ll experience with Nortech under our new brand:


- **Reliability in Demanding Environments** – From medical devices to aerospace applications, we deliver solutions for industries where performance is non-negotiable. Decades of experience in medical, aerospace, defense, and industrial markets ensure we understand the unique challenges you face.
- **Precision and Customization Through Expert Engineering** – We provide **customized solutions** for even the most complex challenges, always meeting the precise standards required for critical devices and assemblies. From **medical imaging** advancements to **aerospace-grade components** , our expertise bridges complex technologies and practical applications.
- **Industry-Leading Design and Manufacturing Solutions** – Nortech is structured to seamlessly handle every stage of production, including wire/cable assemblies, printed circuit board assemblies, system-level integration, and final tests. This streamlined approach allows us to meet the highest levels of quality and reliability.


- **Quality and Customization:** With secure design processes and precise engineering, we meet even the most complex specifications.
- **Secure and Innovative Data Management** – Data connectivity plays an increasingly vital role in today’s world. Nortech applies secure digital tools to analyze and manage critical data, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and compliance across all projects.
- **Sustainability and Innovation:** Our efforts are driven by a culture of continual improvement, sustainability, and long-term growth.
- **A Culture Rooted in Values** – Nortech places teamwork, excellence, commitment, innovation and integrity at its core. By working collaboratively with our customers, we help pinpoint challenges, offer unique market insights, and guide them in navigating potential hurdles. Our **transparent partnerships** ensure confidence and clarity at every step.


## Nortech Values


**Reimagining Connections into the Future**


Rebranding is more than a new logo or tagline; it’s about redefining our purpose and building deeper connections. Our refreshed brand is a promise—one of reimagined connections and grounded in innovation, dedication, and customer-centricity. This rebrand sets the stage for an exciting future of innovation, collaboration, and growth. By **redefining how we connect** —internally and externally—we position Nortech as not just a solutions provider, but a trusted advisor and strategic partner. Whether you’re developing next-generation **fiber optic components** , navigating complex regulatory landscapes in the **medical device market** , or optimizing production for industrial applications, Nortech is here to help you solve the challenges of tomorrow.


With six facilities and design centers across the U.S., Latin America, and Asia, we have the global reach and localized expertise to stay by your side wherever you do business.


To learn more about Nortech Systems and how our **modernized solutions** can empower your business, visit[stgnortech.wpengine.com](http://stgnortech.wpengine.com/) today. Let’s build a stronger future, together.
